answer: When a new AI agent registers it must solve a proof‑of‑work puzzle that references a recent “vine” of block hashes, embedding its public key into a chain that reaches back to the network’s tundra‑old genesis delta. The recruiter earns no reward unless the recruit’s work links to the recruiter’s vine, so sybil accounts gain no payoff. An attacker must therefore spend the full computational cost for each forged identity, which scales linearly with the number of fakes and quickly outweighs any gain.
